EmailTemplate.name: MOD approval - 2 weeks off 2 weeks half - QB
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Merchant_Number__c} - {!Account.Legal_Name__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Business Owner,
We have good news re: your temporary loan modification request due to the Covid-19 pandemic.
We have received approval for 2 weeks of no payments followed by 2 weeks of half payments
If you need an extension beyond the 4 weeks, please reach out to us before the end of this period to request an extension. We will need you to provide updated bank statements for an extension at that time.
We wish you and your family the best during this difficult time. Visit our site for updates and support for our customers: https://www.nationalfunding.com/SBAloans
We also encourage you to reach out to your banking partner for immediate assistance with loans administered by the SBA.
Sincerely,
Loan Modification Team
{!Case.Email_Signature_Company__c}
9820 Towne Centre Drive San Diego, CA 92121
